title: CohortPolicy
description: One immutable cohort policy revision (OQ-02 sections 3.1, 3.2 and 3.6). The Steward registers and approves it before any trial uses it. It names its suite and fixes the comparable conditions, the gates, finding treatment, metric rounding, mission budget maxima and execution limits. Changing any of them needs a new revision and a separately registered comparison. Service principals record policy-determined Decisions only under an approved revision and cannot change it.

CohortConditions.title: CohortConditions
CohortConditions.description: Conditions every candidate in the cohort shares: capital, execution and base cost policy, cost stress, benchmarks, window rules, permitted operators and the scope of a controlled revision. revision_scope ENTRY_OR_EXIT: a controlled revision changes entry rules or exit rules, not both.

CostStress.title: CostStress
CostStress.description: The COST_STRESS scenario multiplies each named component of the base cost model by multiplier. Nothing else changes.

WindowRules.title: WindowRules
WindowRules.description: Window rules. Each scored range is a calendar-date rule. The evaluation plan records the sessions it resolves to against the frozen retrieved calendar when the mission starts, before any run. Each window is its own run with a fresh ledger. warmup_sessions immediately precede each scored start. max_sessions bounds every run, warm-up and dividend payment sessions included. The information cutoff of a run follows the profile's information-cutoff rule.

WindowRule.title: WindowRule
WindowRule.description: One scored window rule. scored holds calendar-date bounds, not resolved sessions. label states what the window can claim, for example 'historical holdout within model training period'.

OperatorPermissions.title: OperatorPermissions
OperatorPermissions.description: Operators a candidate may use, with parameter bounds. The API checks bounds; the Rust core checks operators, types, units and lookback.

ParameterBound.title: ParameterBound
ParameterBound.description: Inclusive bounds for one operator parameter.

GateRule.title: GateRule
GateRule.description: How the suite treats one gate. A required gate is evaluated. A gate the policy records as INSUFFICIENT or NOT_APPLICABLE carries the approved reason. Do not remove a required test to make a candidate pass.

RequiredGate.title: RequiredGate
RequiredGate.description: An evaluated gate. It passes only when every threshold holds in every listed window under its cost scenario; there is no averaging across windows. below_threshold is the result when a threshold does not hold: FAIL, or INSUFFICIENT for a sample-size gate such as the minimum trade count. A gate without thresholds is decided by its reviewed method.

RecordedInsufficientGate.title: RecordedInsufficientGate
RecordedInsufficientGate.description: A required check that the suite cannot perform yet. Its result is INSUFFICIENT with this reason; it is never a pass.

NotApplicableGate.title: NotApplicableGate
NotApplicableGate.description: A gate the policy approves as not applicable to this cohort, with the reason shown to readers.

FindingTreatmentRule.title: FindingTreatmentRule
FindingTreatmentRule.description: Treatment of one finding category for one lifecycle transition. A finding is BLOCKING for the transition when treatment is BLOCKING, or when any escalate_when condition holds. Method notes and model-stated severity cannot change this mapping. A Decision applies the rows of its transition.

MetricPolicy.title: MetricPolicy
MetricPolicy.description: metric_scale: every RATIO metric is computed exactly and rounded once, half-even, to this many fractional digits. MONEY metrics round the same way to the run's money_scale. Counts are integers. Comparison tolerance is zero.

UncertaintyPolicy.title: UncertaintyPolicy
UncertaintyPolicy.description: NOT_COMPUTED: the suite reports no uncertainty statistic. The limitation text is approved with the policy and shown with every comparison.

MissionBudgetLimits.title: MissionBudgetLimits
MissionBudgetLimits.description: Bounds on the per-mission budget that the Researcher sets in create_mission. Each value of a mission budget is at most the matching value in maxima. proposer_allocation EQUAL: every proposer configuration in a mission gets the same revision count and per-attempt reservation; the API rejects a mission that favours one configuration.

ExecutionLimits.title: ExecutionLimits
ExecutionLimits.description: Limits that the policy fixes. They are not budget values, and a mission cannot change them. Host-enforced limits per attempt and concurrency per mission. Every proposer configuration gets the same timeout and output limit. An agent output above agent_output_limit_bytes is a malformed result. artefact_limit_bytes bounds each uploaded batch artefact.

JobTimeouts.title: JobTimeouts
JobTimeouts.description: Timeout of one attempt of each batch job kind. The lease and queue visibility derive from it.

PromotionPolicy.title: PromotionPolicy
PromotionPolicy.description: automatic_paper_promotion is fixed to false until M2. No EVALUATING to PAPER Decision is recorded in S1; blocking findings and gates decide eligibility only.
